info.title: Korbit API
info.description: API de pagamentos da Korbit para merchants: PIX, cartão (com 3DS), assinaturas, checkout por link, payouts, antecipações e refunds — com idempotência, webhooks assinados e ambiente sandbox.

get.description: Streams every row of the filtered list as CSV (semicolon-separated, UTF-8 with BOM). Read it as a stream; do not buffer it. Refused with 422 EXPORT_TOO_LARGE above 100000 rows.
